---
title: Git-like version control
description: How Apiome versions map to Git commits, tags, forks, branches and merges.
sidebar_position: 1.25
tags: [versions, branches, merge, tags, fork]
---

A project's versions form a history much like a Git repository's. Each version is a **revision**
with a parent, a published version is frozen like a released commit, and **tags** are named
pointers to a version. Branches, merges and rollbacks build on the same history graph:

```text
  main:  o---o---o---o  (tip)
              \
  feature:     o---o---o  (branch tip)
                     \
                      merge → new revision (2 parents)
```

Most of this works today in the web app, the CLI and the API. The **branch, merge and rollback
controls in the web app are switched off**. See [Turning on the Git-like controls](#turning-on-the-git-like-controls).

## Git concepts in Apiome

| In Git | In Apiome | Where | Available |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Commit | A new version (a revision of the project) | **New version** on [Versions](./versions.mdx); [Cut a version](../ship/cut-a-version.md) | Yes |
| Log, history | The revision graph, its ancestors and the merge base of two revisions | [Revision history and merge base](./revision-history.md) (API) | Yes |
| Reflog, audit | Who published, merged, tagged or changed protection | [Project activity timeline](./project-timeline.md) | Yes |
| Diff | Compare two versions: documents, breaking changes, migration guide | **Compare** in [Version dialogs](./version-dialogs.mdx#compare); [Compare published versions](../ship/compare-published-versions.md) (CLI) | Yes |
| Tag | Version tags (`stable`, `prod` …), which can be immutable or protected | [`apiome tags`](./versions.mdx#list-version-tags-from-the-cli) (CLI) and the [version tags API](../reference/rest/version-tags.md); **Tag this revision** in the web app is switched off | CLI and API |
| Fork | Copy a version into another project, recording where it came from | [`apiome versions fork`](./versions.mdx#fork-a-version-into-another-project-from-the-cli) and `POST /v1/versions/{tenant}/{project}/fork`; **Fork to another project…** in the web app is switched off | CLI and API |
| Release, protect | Publish a version; freeze its schema; unpublish it with a reason | [Publish a version](../ship/publish-a-version.md), [Freeze a version's schema](../ship/publish-a-version.md#freeze-a-versions-schema) | Yes |
| CI merge gate | Fail a build when a new version breaks the previous one | [Version compatibility gate](../reference/ci/version-compatibility-gate.md) | Yes |
| End of life | Deprecate a version and schedule its sunset | **Schedule sunset** in [Version dialogs](./version-dialogs.mdx#schedule-sunset); [Sunset timeline](../ship/sunset-timeline.mdx) | Yes |
| Branch | Start a named branch at a revision | **Branch from here** | Switched off |
| Merge | Preview and apply a merge of two branches, resolving conflicts path by path | **Merge branches…** | Switched off |
| Revert, reset | Move a branch back to an earlier revision | **Rollback branch to this revision…** | Switched off |
| Branch protection | Lock a revision against deletion | **Lock revision (delete policy)** | Switched off |

## What is not like Git

- **No push or pull.** A project lives in Apiome, not in a clone. To bring changes in from a Git
  repository or send them back, use [Sources](./versions.mdx#sources) and [Sync back to
  repositories](./versions.mdx#sync-back-to-repositories) on the Versions page.
- **A tag keeps only where it points now.** Apiome records who created a tag, not who moved it, so
  there is no move history.
- **A fork copies classes, not paths.** Its summary says how many paths the source has.
- **A version created on its own is a root.** The first version of a project, a **New version** and
  an import have no parent, so two such versions have no merge base. See [How revisions
  link](./revision-history.md#how-revisions-link).

## Turning on the Git-like controls

<Flag name="FEATURE_GITLIKE" />

The **Branch from here**, **Merge branches…**, **Rollback branch to this revision…**, **Fork to
another project…**, **Tag this revision** and **Lock revision (delete policy)** controls are built
but switched off. `FEATURE_GITLIKE` is a constant in `apiome-ui/lib/feature-flags.ts`, `false` in
every shipped build. Turning them on takes a code change and a rebuild. [Version
dialogs](./version-dialogs.mdx#git-like-features) lists each control and what it does.

The CLI and the API don't depend on this switch: forking and tagging work there today.
